They will be given a place in Jannat al-Firdaws, and on the Day of Judgement they will have no dread of any kind, nor will they be afflicted with fear of any kind. Those qualities of the believers are as follows.

paras.text: As we know, after the articles of faith the second rank is that of acts of worship, and after acts of worship the third rank is that of dealings. The true believers are those who believe in Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, offer prayer, and pay zakat out of the wealth that Allah has granted them. [… text hidden by a folded corner …] has been mentioned again and again in the Holy Quran. In fact these acts of worship are the best [way] of expressing faith [… hidden …]. The third sign has been stated to be that they do good deeds. The scope of good deeds [is very wide] …

[… متن د ماتې شوې ګوټ لاندې پټ دی …] په قرآن مجید کې بیا بیا یاد شوی. په اصل کې دا عبادات د ایمان د څرګندولو غوره [طریقه] ده [… پټ …]. درېیمه نښه دا ښوول شوې چې نېک عملونه کوي. د نېکو عملونو ساحه [ډېره پراخه ده] …

sections.theory:
Verse no. 277

اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَاَقَامُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتَوُا الزَّكٰوةَ لَهُمْ اَجْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُوْنَ

Translation: Those people who believed and did good deeds, and kept offering prayer and giving zakat — they will receive the reward of their deeds with Allah, and on the Day of Judgement they will have no fear at all, nor will they be grieved.

Explanation

In this blessed verse Allah the Exalted has mentioned those qualities of the believers by virtue of which Allah the Exalted will grant them the best reward. They will be given a place in Jannat al-Firdaws, and on the Day of Judgement they will have no dread of any kind, nor will they be afflicted with fear of any kind. Those qualities of the believers are as follows.

a. They do good deeds.

b. They establish prayer.

c. They pay zakat.

As we know, after the articles of faith the second rank is that of acts of worship, and after acts of worship the third rank is that of dealings. The true believers are those who believe in Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, offer prayer, and pay zakat out of the wealth that Allah has granted them. [… text hidden by a folded corner …] has been mentioned again and again in the Holy Quran. In fact these acts of worship are the best [way] of expressing faith [… hidden …]. The third sign has been stated to be that they do good deeds. The scope of good deeds [is very wide] …

ب۔ نماز قائم کرتے ہیں۔

ج۔ زکوٰۃ ادا کرتے ہیں۔

جیسا کہ ہم جانتے ہیں کہ ایمانیات کے بعد دوسرا درجہ عبادات کا ہے اور عبادات کے بعد تیسرا درجہ معاملات کا ہے۔ اصل ایمان والے وہ ہوتے ہیں جو اللہ اور اس کے رسول صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہٖ وسلم پر ایمان لا[تے ہیں]، نماز ادا کرتے ہیں اور جو مال انہیں اللہ نے عطا کیا ہے اس میں سے زکوٰۃ ادا کرتے ہیں۔ [… مڑے ہوئے کونے کے نیچے متن چھپا ہوا …] قرآن مجید میں بار بار ذکر آیا ہے۔ دراصل یہ عبادات ایمان کے اظہار کا بہترین ط[ریقہ] [… چھپا ہوا …] تیسری نشانی یہ بتائی گئی ہے کہ وہ نیک عمل کرتے ہیں۔ نیک اعمال کا دائرہ کار ب[ہت وسیع ہے] …

Verse no. 277

اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَاَقَامُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتَوُا الزَّكٰوةَ لَهُمْ اَجْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُوْنَ

Translation: Those people who believed and did good deeds, and kept offering prayer and giving zakat — they will receive the reward of their deeds with Allah, and on the Day of Judgement they will have no fear at all, nor will they be grieved.

Explanation

In this blessed verse Allah the Exalted has mentioned those qualities of the believers by virtue of which Allah the Exalted will grant them the best reward. They will be given a place in Jannat al-Firdaws, and on the Day of Judgement they will have no dread of any kind, nor will they be afflicted with fear of any kind. Those qualities of the believers are as follows.

a. They do good deeds.

b. They establish prayer.

c. They pay zakat.

As we know, after the articles of faith the second rank is that of acts of worship, and after acts of worship the third rank is that of dealings. The true believers are those who believe in Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, offer prayer, and pay zakat out of the wealth that Allah has granted them. [… text hidden by a folded corner …] has been mentioned again and again in the Holy Quran. In fact these acts of worship are the best [way] of expressing faith [… hidden …]. The third sign has been stated to be that they do good deeds. The scope of good deeds [is very wide] …
